steps.message: I’ll inspect the local Maven manifests and current source references first, then apply the Spring Boot parent bump and fix any resulting production-code build issues without touching tests.

todos.content: Inspect Maven manifests and dependency state
Apply spring-boot-starter-parent 3.1.1 upgrade and regenerate metadata if present
Build/test compile to identify upgrade breakages
Patch production code for Spring Boot 3.1.1 compatibility
